preview.title: Start with your amount
preview.xorBudget: XOR budget, including the burn fee
preview.start: Enter an amount to see an estimate before connecting a wallet.
preview.futureTs: Estimated TS for a future claim
preview.burnable: From about {xor} XOR available to burn after the estimated SORA fees and a price buffer.
preview.partialXor: About {xor} XOR could remain to burn. The TS reward cannot currently be estimated.
preview.additionalGas: Ethereum conversion and bridge fees are not included. Keep extra ETH for gas. The conversion and bridge reviews check these costs; the card quote alone does not prove that every step is covered.
preview.cardEth: MoonPay currently estimates {eth} ETH delivered. Some ETH must be kept for gas, so the eventual TS amount will be lower if this purchase also funds those costs.
preview.dai: Estimated conversion output: {amount} DAI. Quoted minimum: {minimum} DAI. A fresh review is required before converting or bridging.
preview.impact: Current DAI → XOR price impact: {impact}%. The route limit is 5%.
preview.checkpoint: Campaign reward calculated through finalized block {block}.
preview.tonRoute: TON USDT first uses a provider handoff to Ethereum ETH, then converts to DAI. TON gas and Ethereum gas are additional. Native TON must first be swapped to USDT on TON.
preview.cardTerms: MoonPay sets regional availability, eligibility, payment limits and final fees. This public card estimate does not reserve a rate or start a purchase.
preview.method: This is an indicative plan, refreshed every 30 seconds. SORA estimates include a conservative conversion/slippage buffer. Provider amounts, gas and campaign availability can change before the final review.
preview.claim: TS is reserved for a future claim by the same SORA signing wallet. TONSWAP mainnet has not launched; no launch date is promised. Burning XOR is irreversible.

reason.invalid-amount: Enter a positive amount with the supported number of decimals.
reason.unsupported-asset: This asset is not supported for the selected source.
reason.card-provider: The card provider could not return an estimate. You can prepare your wallets and review the provider's quote before paying.
reason.card-minimum: The provider returned a total of {minimum} USD, above your budget. Increase your budget only if you accept that amount; no purchase has started.
reason.native-ton: A direct native TON quote is not available. Swap TON to USDT on TON first, or prepare your wallets and use the guided route.
reason.mainnet: Waiting for a verified SORA mainnet connection. You can prepare your wallets while the estimate is unavailable.
reason.fees-unavailable: Current SORA fees are unavailable, so a net TS estimate would be incomplete.
reason.fees-insufficient: This amount would not leave XOR to burn after fees. Try a larger amount.
reason.conversion-unavailable: The provider could not quote this conversion. You can prepare your wallets, but review a working quote before funding.
reason.conversion-impact: The conversion exceeds the 5% price-impact limit. Try a smaller amount or wait for better liquidity.
reason.liquidity-unavailable: The DAI → XOR quote is unavailable. No token output has been assumed.
reason.price-impact: The DAI → XOR price impact exceeds 5%. Try a smaller amount or wait for better liquidity.
reason.campaign-unavailable: The current campaign totals could not be verified. A TS reward estimate will appear when fresh data is available.
reason.cap-exceeded: This amount exceeds the remaining campaign capacity. Reduce the amount before continuing.
reason.expired: The estimate expired while checking the route. Try again for current rates.

preview.ethereumGasSummary: Ethereum gas is not included yet. We check it after you connect your wallets.
preview.tonGasSummary: TON and Ethereum gas are not included yet. You will need both for this route.
